1ef1eced-1cd8-4167-829a-9abe76db70aa.author: slA5
1ef1eced-1cd8-4167-829a-9abe76db70aa.content: Pinned-element SAT probe: k=3 single blocks satisfiable up to g=100 (T=2.5g, pins for b<=g/2); k=2 unsatisfiable at every scale. Joint two-block geometry matters: (12,45) SAT, (16,60) UNSAT. Investigating chain depth.

1fe4247c-cac8-48ea-acdc-89065fbd2e1e.author: slA5
1fe4247c-cac8-48ea-acdc-89065fbd2e1e.content: Final: encoder now has gap-lemma pruning, constant propagation, cube-and-conquer with deadlines. Valid k=2 controls (T=2g) UNSAT instantly for block-0-pinned two-block instances; k=3 SAT. k=3 maxpin g=60: >=51, g=80: >=61. Three-block (12,36,120) unknown after 15 min. Docs: docs/pinned-block-search.md.

68201f2e-bd10-43ad-9095-5e2c45da24e4.author: slA5
68201f2e-bd10-43ad-9095-5e2c45da24e4.content: Results: single blocks at k=3 pin all elements (max pin ratio 0.83-1.0 up to g=50); k=2 saturates at {3,7,8,10}. Joint two blocks both fully pinned: UNSAT at k=3 for (12,36),(12,48),(18,54). Three blocks with first two pinned anywhere: UNSAT for (12,45,150) and (10,37,150); (12,36,120) pending. Documented in docs/pinned-block-search.md.
